content.text: Do you have MacBook Pro M4 in stock?

Yes, we have 7 units of the 14-inch M4 16GB/512GB in Space Black, 4 units of the 16-inch M4 Pro 24GB/1TB in Silver, and 2 units of the 14-inch M4 Max 36GB/1TB in Space Black. Higher-end 16-inch M4 Max configs are on order with 10-14 day ETA.
How much is the 14-inch MacBook Pro M4 Pro?
The 14-inch M4 Pro with 24GB memory and 1TB SSD is $1,999 USD.
What chip options are available for MacBook Pro M4?
MacBook Pro M4 offers three chip options: M4 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU), M4 Pro (12-core CPU, 16-core GPU), and M4 Max (16-core CPU, 40-core GPU).
How long is the battery life on the 16-inch MacBook Pro M4?
The 16-inch MacBook Pro M4 has up to 24 hours of video playback battery life.
Do you have iPhone 13 Pro Max in stock?
Yes, we have 12 units of 128 GB Sierra Blue, 8 units of 256 GB Graphite, and 3 units of 512 GB Alpine Green. Other configurations are on order with 7-10 day ETA.
What is the price of the iPhone 13 Pro Max 256 GB?
The iPhone 13 Pro Max 256 GB is $1,199 USD.
What colors does the iPhone 13 Pro Max come in?
iPhone 13 Pro Max comes in Sierra Blue, Gold, Silver, Graphite, and Alpine Green.
Is the iPhone 13 Pro Max water resistant?
Yes, iPhone 13 Pro Max has IP68 water resistance.
Tell me about the Apple Watch Series 11.
Apple Watch Series 11 is Apple's flagship smartwatch with the S11 SiP, Always-On Retina LTPO3 display up to 2000 nits, available in 42mm and 46mm cases, with Aluminum and Titanium options.
How much is the Apple Watch Series 11 titanium model?
The Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium is $749 USD, and the 46mm Titanium is $799 USD.
What is the battery life on the Apple Watch Series 11?
Apple Watch Series 11 has up to 36 hours of typical use battery life, and up to 72 hours in Low Power Mode.
Do you have the Apple Watch Series 11 in Titanium Natural?
Yes, we have 5 units of GPS + Cellular 46mm Titanium Natural in stock.
What is your return policy?

Customers may return most items within 14 calendar days of receipt for a refund to the original payment method. Items must be in original packaging with all accessories. Engraved or personalized products are non-refundable except for manufacturing defects.
What are your store hours?
The store is open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sunday from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day.
Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
The standard one-year limited warranty does not cover accidental damage. AppleCare+ adds unlimited incidents of accidental damage protection, subject to a service fee per incident.
Which is cheaper, the iPhone 13 Pro Max 128GB or the MacBook Pro M4 14-inch base?
The iPhone 13 Pro Max 128 GB is $1,099 USD, while the 14-inch MacBook Pro M4 16GB/512GB is $1,599 USD. The iPhone is $500 cheaper.
What is the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 option?
The cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 is the GPS 42mm Aluminum at $399 USD.
Is the 1TB Gold iPhone 13 Pro Max available right now?
The 1 TB Gold iPhone 13 Pro Max is currently out of stock. It is on order with an ETA of 7 to 10 business days.
How fast does in-stock MacBook Pro ship after I order?
In-stock MacBook Pro M4 base configurations typically ship within 48 hours of order confirmation.
Do you have any Samsung Galaxy phones?
I only handle Apple product questions - anything else?
